dedupe_keys.name: where charged electricity imports are replaced interconnector outages and a graph network response model for the eu cbam code

description: Zirui Tong and colleagues publish code for a European electricity-network response model used to examine where lost imports are replaced after interconnector outages. Zenodo lists a public MIT-licensed source snapshot, and the linked repository documents a spatiotemporal graph model with an energy-balance dispatch head and a state-dependent linear network-response layer. It tests named HVDC and Serbia–Hungary outages across 27 bidding zones and compares resulting electricity-import carbon charges. The separately linked data repository holds processed inputs, weights and paper outputs; source code alone does not reproduce the study. No catalogue record explicitly covers this model. A limitation is that raw source data must come from external providers, and transfer to future grid conditions depends on updated network and market inputs. The code and data repository were read as metadata only; no training, outage run or charge estimate was reproduced.
